fact: SeSoDa, a 1,966-pair Sesotho-English dataset by authors at the National University of Lesotho, was published with its code, dataset and baseline model open-sourced under ODC-By.
title: SeSoDa: A Compact Context-Rich Sesotho-English Dataset for LoRA Fine-Tuning of SLMs
publisher: Journal of the Digital Humanities Association of Southern Africa (DHASA)
